aggregation: within-seed event aggregate; across-seed arithmetic mean and sample SD ddof1; paired delta per identical seed; no ensemble
exclusion_reason: Separate historical single-seed exploration scope, retained in original report; not metric-value filtering
frozen_validation_digest_limitation: Selected endpoint files do not include target/truth digests. Shared original Validation population SHA is verified, selected state/count/threshold/loader/source closure linked; no claim of fresh full-prediction verification for those endpoints.

original_GPU_endpoint_vs_followup_Valida.interpretation: runtime numerical difference within predeclared tolerance; scientific condition and conclusions unchanged

presentation_rules.summary_Time_NLL: absolute signed mean delta for overall and tail; scientific notation below 1e-4
presentation_rules.paired_Time_NLL_relative_percent: display em dash only when abs(baseline_mean)<1e-6; all original percent/denominator/delta values retained in CSV
presentation_rules.worst_seed: largest absolute model metric and largest paired delta both retained; negative maximum delta means all seeds improved
